name: Whole Roasted Fish With Fresh Herbs and Lemon

ingredients.name: kosher salt, plus more for seasoning
Extra-virgin olive oil, for rubbing and drizzling

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large bowl with 2 quarts room-temperature water and add salt, stirring to dissolve. Add fish and let soak for 10 minutes. Drain fish and pat dry inside and out with paper towels.

Preheat oven to 400°F and position rack in center of oven. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Season fish inside and out with salt and pepper and rub inside and out with olive oil. Stuff belly cavity lemon slices and herb sprigs.

Roast fish until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 135°F, about 20 minutes for 1-pound fish and 25 minutes for 2-pound fish, depending on dimensions of fish. Alternatively, roast until fins come right off when pulled and flesh can be felt to flake under the skin when you press on it. Let rest 5 minutes. Serve, following our guide to filleting a whole cooked fish. Drizzle with additional olive oil, if desired.

description: Roasting fish whole is one of the easiest, most delicious ways to cook it. Cooked on the bone and in its skin, the meat remains more tender and juicy than fillets or steaks do.
author: Daniel Gritzer
